answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, utilizing a staked collateral trellis to validate network participants. By requiring agents to lock capital, the protocol prevents the ripple effect of malicious actor proliferation. Attackers face the sable cost of asset devaluation and total forfeiture of bonded equity if they attempt to create fake identities to manipulate consensus, effectively anchoring digital influence to verifiable economic risk rather than arbitrary pseudonymous nodes.
